race.description: Asahi Super Dry Kingston Town Stakes (G2)
race.comment: THE EUPHRATES (11) imported stayer who made his Australian debut with a gritty on-pace fourth in the G2 Chelmsford Stakes with 59kg over 1600m at this track. Well placed at the set weights and will keep improving as he steps out in trip. Can slide across and take control early. SOUL OF SPAIN (3) tough stayer unlucky not to win the Sydney Cup in the autumn. Has impressed in two runs back and can get the better of these from the good gate. PIGGYBACK (14) warmed up late along the inside with a tidy seventh in the G2 Chelmsford Stakes at this track. Should be cherry-ripe now with the sharp weight drop. Each-way prospect. ELIYASS (2) good win here two back over the 1800m, then anchored with the 62kg when he tired late in a bunched finish to run fifth in the LR Wyong Gold Cup. Drops 5.5kg for this and will roll forward from the draw. Keep safe. BONIFACE (8) has a fitness edge over most of these and is capable of raising the bar after his recent form has been franked.
